resolved.Name: S6
resolved.Title: non-retryable errors (10% HTTP 400)
resolved.Description: From 30s to 150s soar answers 10% of requests with HTTP 400 (seeded, deterministic per request index). A 400 is non-retryable: the whole batch of that request goes to the DLQ (fsync first). The DLQ set must equal the set of events the mock rejected with 4xx; everything else is delivered.

notes: kill = SIGKILL; graceful stop = SIGTERM. kill -9 is not power loss (page cache survives).
